skippd.name: SKIPP'D (Stanford SKy Images and Photovoltaic Power Dataset)
skippd.source: Stanford Environmental Assessment and Optimization (EAO) Group
skippd.description: 3 years (2017-2019) of 1-min 640x480 all-sky images paired with 1-min GHI and 30kW PV power generation.
skippd.citation: Nie, Y., et al. (2023). SKIPP'D: A SKy Images and Photovoltaic Power Generation Dataset. Solar Energy.
download_instructions: Option B (Stanford Digital Repository direct download):

folsom.name: Folsom Solar Irradiance and Sky Images Dataset
folsom.description: 3 years (2014-2016) of 1-second GHI and DNI ground radiometers with 1-min all-sky camera images in Folsom, CA.
folsom.citation: Pedro, H. T., Larson, D. P., & Coimbra, C. F. (2019). A comprehensive dataset for solar forecasting. Renewable Energy.
download_instructions: Download Zenodo archive using Zenodo API or browser:

nrel_srrl.name: NREL SRRL (Solar Radiation Research Laboratory - BMS & TSI880)
nrel_srrl.source: National Renewable Energy Laboratory, Golden, CO
nrel_srrl.description: Gold standard research radiometer baseline (GHI, DNI, DHI, Linke Turbidity) paired with Total Sky Imager TSI-880 images.
nrel_srrl.citation: NREL Solar Radiation Research Laboratory Baseline Measurement System (BMS). Golden, Colorado.
download_instructions: Access NREL MIDC direct export portal at https://midc.nrel.gov/srrl_bms/
Select parameters: Global Horizontal (CMP22 / PSP), Direct Normal (NIP), Sky Imager (TSI-880).
